[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Issuance of a Task Order Agreement to MTX Group Inc.: Under the City of Los Angeles Information Technology Agency Master Service Agreement C-141974, covering design, development, and implementation of a salesforce-based eSourcing solution for Los Angeles World Airports, for term ending no later than November 16, 2027 and for cost not to exceed $1,449,568.89 (Mark Frank)
